title: When Bitcoin’s modest gain meets Portal’s rocket launch
content:
Bitcoin: “I’m just chilling at +1.5%.”
Portal: “Hold my coffee, I’m going +88% in 24h!”
Me at 3 AM: “Did I just miss the portal to the moon or is this a meme?”
lesson: Don’t chase the hyper‑gainers; set alerts and stick to your risk‑reward plan.
question: Who else woke up to Portal’s fireworks and almost sold the whole bag? Be honest 👇
